generator.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one dedicated L0 logistics gatehouse environment background plate for a bounded game room stage. Generate exactly one new native 3840 x 2160 PNG, 16:9, without enlarging a smaller source. Primary scene: the INTERIOR of a small single-story logistics depot gatehouse, unmistakably a guard booth, not a loading yard. Camera is inside the narrow enclosed duty space looking toward a large old rectangular glass observation window and a compact built-in registration counter directly underneath it. Window frames, booth interior ceiling, both side walls and the counter must define a clear small gatehouse shell occupying the central 60% of the composition. The counter is entirely bare, no paperwork or objects, its wood or steel surface worn and scratched, no lettering. Old dusty glass with subtle fine scratches remains transparent enough to show a distant logistics perimeter fence and a small portion of an out-of-focus loading canopy beyond the fence, all outdoors well behind the window; the distant yard must be secondary, no giant foreground warehouse shutter. Small utilitarian enclosed booth scale, institutional concrete plinth, weathered dark grey-blue painted steel window frames, rough off-white plaster above muted teal-grey lower panels, scuffed concrete floor, one narrow unmarked doorframe at an interior side. No glass breaking that prevents recognizing the window. Photorealistic cinematic game-environment illustration, cold dark realistic materials, faint cold overcast ambient light through window, one subdued warm utility lamp on an inside wall, readable shadow midtones, dense credible texture and natural scale. Stable eye-level 28 mm wide architectural composition, no dutch angle, no dramatic blur in the booth itself. Keep the window, broad mullions, compact counter and surrounding interior structure central and recognizable after moderate side crop. Leave low center foreground floor clear for an independently rendered action panel; avoid huge foreground objects. Absolutely no people, NPC, enemy, human silhouette, human reflection, body, blood, gore. No text, labels, words, letters, numbers, signs, logo, watermark, HUD, UI, interface frame, icon, map, diagram or screen. No desk computer, phone, radio, camera monitor, clock, keys, keycard, tools, documents, cups, bottles, supplies, loose objects, loot, rewards or collectible material. No shop or improvised reward station. Exterior fence and distant loading yard are atmospheric context only, not a new route map or direct movement action. This dedicated image represents the logistics guard booth L0 only and must not be mistaken for the L2 loading bay. Deliver one clean full-bleed native 3840x2160 PNG.
